newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Efisa, Credit Suisse set loan for Portugal's RTP.
newsitem.headline: Efisa, Credit Suisse set loan for Portugal's RTP.

text.p: Portuguese bank Banco Efisa and Credit Suisse First Boston set up a syndicated loan, without a state guarantee, for 22 billion escudos for state broadcaster RTP-Radiotelevisao Portuguesa (RTP), Banco Efisa said.
"The financing was placed by a syndicate of European banks with a maximum term of seven years," a statement said.
The interest rate is indexed to Lisbor.
The European banks in the syndicate are Commerzbank, Bankgesellschaft Berlin, Dresdner Bank and Royal Bank of Scotland.
